subject: Life Skills

source.topic: Beginning Knowledge: Creatures that live in water
source.subtopic: Salt water creatures in the sea (shark, crayfish) and rock pools (starfish, crab); classify and compare

show.line: Some creatures live in rivers and dams. Some live in the salty sea!

rounds.prompt: Which lives in a rock pool?
How does a fish breathe in water?
Which sea animal has eight arms?
Which can live in water and on land?

hints: Rivers and dams have fresh water. The sea is salty.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A shark lives in...
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Sharks live in the sea.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Sharks live in the salty sea!

parent_line: Can sort fresh water and sea creatures.
